name: Sethekk Halls
shortDescription: Sethekk Halls, a named setting in the Karazhan research story.
body: The associated original environment art preserves these Pale carved draenei mausoleum stone, high arches and broken mosaics under cool violet light, distinct from the dark industrial Shattered Halls. It remains an interpretive scene; no exact route, dungeon layout or surveyed coordinate is asserted.
